answer: The strongest lever is simple: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because jetty only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, sable is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any mirror approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
